build_constant_momentum_scheduler: build a ConstantMomentum scheduler to decay optimizer momentum by a constant factor until a milestone
build_cosine_annealing_momentum_schedule: build a CosineAnnealingMomentum scheduler to anneal optimizer momentum using a cosine schedule
build_exponential_momentum_scheduler: build an ExponentialMomentum scheduler to decay optimizer momentum by gamma each epoch
build_linear_momentum_scheduler: build a LinearMomentum scheduler to linearly change the momentum multiplicative factor over epochs
